Effect.Name: Transformation
Effect.Hint: When this effect lands on a character, the character's owner gets a window to choose one of their saved looks for the token. When the effect ends or is disabled, the token returns to its own look. Mark it on a domain card's effect to have the card's action trigger it.

Picker.Title: Transformation

Picker.CopyNoTarget: Target a token to copy it
Picker.CopyName: Take the name too when copying a token
Picker.NoTarget: Target the token whose look you want to copy.
